question: What fault does the author find in the logicians who defend this position?
premises: The opponents are blinded by attachment to their own side.
They repeatedly forget even what they themselves have accepted.
They pride themselves on being logicians.
inference: Their attachment to their own position makes them inconsistent with their own admitted doctrines.
plain_english: Alas, these people who fancy themselves logicians, blinded by loyalty to their own side, have begun again and again to forget even what they themselves have accepted.
